description: growBiochain(text, {engrams}): the whole grown record (RFC 07 sections 3-10); size edges 1/719/720/721/1,440/1,441/60,000 bytes, characters split by the 720-byte cut, a leading U+FEFF, 0x80 crystal bytes, engram edge cases, and the two input errors. The GROWN/1 commitment and its content hash (section 13) are informative, outside the lock, until an implementation independent of Owl's computes them. Streams longer than 8,192 hex characters are given as <field>_sha256 (lower-case hex SHA-256 of the ASCII stream) and <field>_length.

cases.note: the text starts with U+FEFF (bytes EF BB BF); a verifier keeps it when decoding (RFC 07 section 12.1, step 2)

input.text: Don't count 42 owls; Straße, café, naïve, GEODESIC.
